expectations: Mapping identifies fields, never source truth; current input must be checked again by normal render.
Unstated opposite responsibilities and actor availability remain null. Unknown prices acquire no currency, month, zero or preference.
Capability supports need; maintenance burden requires availability. Hard input effects remain actual dependency effects.
A complete matched source produces a new bounded explanation and view without model advantages, suitability, ranking or causal notes.
The original source conditions stay fixed while local what-if controls change only deterministic eligibility; unknown option facts stay unknown.
Source mismatch, missing mapping, unsupported full source, missing conditions or invented policy cannot gain bound delivery from an old check/turn/revision.
IDs, names and row order may change; final persisted/replayed content must be exactly the final checked display.
A new frozen archive must install through the normal isolated DSH package path and have source commit, manifest, checksums and actual HTTPS assets reconciled.
